review.scope: Partial model review; peer final review did not read tests. Root independently reviewed all owned code/tests and executable evidence. Final signal finding fixed after the last peer review and verified by root.
review.rejected_finding: ResourceBootstrap and repository constructors own no SQL connection, allocate no generation credit and expose no close method. Publication failure needs no invented bootstrap.close; source and a connect-forbidden/missing-secret test verify this.

implemented: Generic single PID/Thread-object owner of its own Popen and pinned kernel process, with no arbitrary PID adoption or agent inventory scan.

Private inherited SOCK_SEQPACKET handshake validates SCM_CREDENTIALS, closed JSON schema, exact configured store/target, boot/start-ticks/pidns/UID/birth/resource view and ACK before resource-runtime admission.
waitid(P_PIDFD) supplies the actual exited/signaled/core-dumped state; ECHILD never synthesizes success. Signals use the pinned handle, never a reusable numeric PID.
Received SCM_RIGHTS descriptors close before any rejection, including truncated packets, with MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC at receive.

Unexpected post-Popen exceptions preserve the first error and retain an exact joinable owner; the Bridge adapter consumes that exceptional handoff. Copy/pickle/fork/foreign threads do not transfer ownership.
SIGTERM/SIGHUP/SIGINT enter the adapter cleanup/join path, handlers are restored afterward and further shutdown signals do not interrupt that physical join.

Bridge publishes from its exact scoped bootstrap before runtime.start; without the inherited FD its existing lifecycle remains. The optional python module launcher has fixed argv and a canonical parent target.

Signal unit scenarios invoke the actually registered callback and check joins/restoration; they do not constitute external SIGKILL/crash recovery acceptance.
The hook precedes resource-runtime admission, not all startup effects: original database initialization/stale-row/backend restoration occurs earlier.

Child instance/generation fields are descriptive until a future funded custodian matches the complete original binding and terminal seal. Python opaque values are trusted-code boundaries, not cryptographic authorization or SQL RLS.

Operator/provider credentials and Claude login were not modified. An empty repair-file guard and stale Docker Desktop bind registration were corrected before readiness acceptance; no container-service replacement.

Strengthened the fixture to require a new handler before invocation; the no-SQL bootstrap case was not executed in this interrupted phase. All are included in the final973.

remaining: Durable whole-generation physical closure and independently funded audited metadata credit custodian remain required for T014. One process exit is insufficient.
The launcher is opt-in; existing external pod/operator deployments are not automatically adopted. Lost Popen acknowledgement or supervisor SIGKILL gives no exit witness.
Startup handshake default30s is conservative; generic receive_binding exposes an explicit timeout. A changed resource view rejects the binding. Cleanup joins without a forced discard deadline.
Unknown native cleanup, provider quotas, elastic placement, physical M1/M2/M3, SDK/UI and global gates remain open; no historical RECONCILE_REQUIRED jobs were closed/replayed.
